prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a bustling school gymnasium hosts a science fair. On the left, a girl in a blue dress stands beside a large poster board covered in charts. Center stage features a tall volcano model made of clay, with red paint simulating lava flowing down its sides. A teacher in a gray suit looks at the volcano while holding a clipboard. Beside the teacher, a small brown dog sits on a folding chair, watching the scene intently. To the right, a man in a red scarf leans against a stack of textbooks, observing the demonstrations. Next to him, a woman in a yellow coat holds a camera up to her eye, capturing the event. In the foreground, a silver robot with glowing eyes stands next to a tangled mess of wires. A child in a green hat reaches out to touch the robot's metal arm. Behind them, a stack of cardboard boxes rests against the wall, partially obscuring a fire extinguisher. A balloon tied to a string floats near the ceiling, drifting above the crowd. A plastic water bottle lies on its side near the robot's feet.
